purpose: Offline model6 real-vehicle speed estimate; not a physical measurement of model6.
simulation_comparison_note: Matched 74-map, 148-trial, seed401, 2 continuous laps development set. Model6 uses its selected stage3 actor evaluation; model5 uses exported policy. Differences from the 580-map final suite are intentional.
real_speed_definition: VESC reported electrical RPM / 3350.0, offset0.0. This is not independent ground speed and cannot detect tyre slip.

model6_prediction.scenario_definition: Assumed +/-10% change in transfer factor; not an empirical confidence interval.

assumptions: Same physical track and sensor setup as November25 model5 trial.
Same calibrated speed conversion, 6m/s cap and 2/3m/s2 command limits.
Relative model6/model5 speed gain across the small-map development set transfers to the real track.
No major change in battery, grip, drivetrain or tracking stability.
limitations: Simulated maps are not a surveyed reconstruction of the physical track.
Only one comparable calibrated physical session; prediction uncertainty is not statistically identified.
Policy rollout speeds depend on its own trajectory, so replaying model5 scans is not a model6 closed-loop test.
Peak speeds depend on straight length and limiter history; no defensible model6 physical peak estimate here.
Model6 had two collisions in the final 2320-trial simulation suite; this speed estimate is not a safety conclusion.
